CLAUDE.md — flightsbr

Source: CLAUDE.md

Project: flightsbr — R package to download flight and airport data from Brazil’s Civil Aviation Agency (ANAC) Maintainer: Rafael H. M. Pereira (Ipea — Institute for Applied Economic Research) Repo: https://github.com/ipeaGIT/flightsbr · Branch: main

Core Principles

  • Plan first — enter plan mode before non-trivial tasks; save plans to quality_reports/plans/
  • R/ is authoritative — man/ (docs) and NAMESPACE are generated by roxygen2. Never hand-edit them; edit the roxygen blocks in R/ and run devtools::document()
  • The release gate is R CMD check --as-cran — 0 errors, 0 warnings, every remaining note justified in cran-comments.md. Run via /r-package-check before any release or merge that touches R/, tests/, or DESCRIPTION
  • [LEARN] tags — when corrected, or when a non-obvious approach is confirmed, save [LEARN:category] wrong → right to MEMORY.md

Cross-session context lives in MEMORY.md; plans, specs, and session logs are in quality_reports/. Workflow rules, skills, and agents are configured globally at ~/.claude (shared with the geobr / geobr-r-package projects) and apply here via path-scoping — see “Skills Quick Reference” below for what’s actually live in this repo.

Folder Structure

flightsbr/
├── CLAUDE.md                    # This file
├── DESCRIPTION / NAMESPACE      # Package metadata / generated exports (never hand-edit NAMESPACE)
├── NEWS.md                      # User-facing changelog (bump per release)
├── cran-comments.md             # CRAN submission notes (NOTE justifications go here)
├── CRAN-SUBMISSION               # CRAN submission record
├── R/                            # Package source — the 5 read_*() functions + utils
├── tests/testthat/               # testthat (edition 3) tests, one file per exported fn
├── man/                          # GENERATED .Rd docs — edit roxygen in R/ instead
├── vignettes/                    # Long-form usage docs
├── inst/                         # Installed files (package-level extras)
├── pkgdown/                      # pkgdown site config
├── .github/workflows/            # R-CMD-check, R-CMD-check-CRAN, pkgdown, test-coverage
├── quality_reports/               # Plans, specs, session logs, merge reports, archive
└── templates/                     # session-log / requirements-spec / quality-report templates

Commands

# Regenerate docs + NAMESPACE after editing roxygen blocks in R/
devtools::document()

# Run the test suite
devtools::test()

# Full CRAN-readiness check (slow — background + monitor for long runs)
devtools::check(args = "--as-cran")

# Test coverage
covr::package_coverage()

# Build the pkgdown site
pkgdown::build_site()
# Local R CMD check equivalent to CI
R CMD build . && R CMD check --as-cran flightsbr_*.tar.gz

CRAN submission: update NEWS.md + bump Version in DESCRIPTION, refresh cran-comments.md with a justification for every remaining NOTE, then devtools::release() (maintainer-only, not automated).

Quality Gate

Check Bar
R CMD check --as-cran 0 errors, 0 warnings, every NOTE explained in cran-comments.md
devtools::test() All tests pass; every exported function has at least one test
Exported function coverage (covr) No exported function at 0%
roxygen docs Every exported function: @param (all args), @return, runnable @examples

Run via /r-package-check before merging changes to R/, tests/, or DESCRIPTION. Full standard: r-package-conventions.md (global rule, path-scoped to R/**/*.R, tests/**/*.R, man/**/*.Rd, DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, NEWS.md).

Note on /commit: the global /commit skill’s Step 0 (scripts/quality_score.py) and Step 0b (scripts/check-surface-sync.sh) are built for the Beamer/Quarto template project — neither script exists here. Skip Step 0/0b for flightsbr; the real gate is /r-package-check, run separately before merging. Steps 1–7 (branch, stage, commit, PR, merge) still apply normally.

Skills Quick Reference

What’s actually live for this repo (full index of ~55 skills lives in the global ~/.claude/skills/, most of it dormant here — the academic paper/slide skillset stays available if a paper or report ever comes out of this data, but isn’t part of the day-to-day loop):

  • Package dev: /r-package-check (the release gate), /code-review, /security-review
  • Workflow: /commit (Step 0/0b skipped — see above), /diagnose, /checkpoint, /context-status, /deep-audit
  • Memory / learning: /learn, /promote-memory
  • Meta: /permission-check, /new-skill

Package Functions

Function Purpose Notes
read_flights() Download national/international flight data (origin/destination, duration, aircraft, payload, passengers) Data dictionary linked in roxygen @description
read_airports() Download all airports/aerodromes registered with ANAC type = "all"/"public"/"private" — public/private return more columns
read_aircraft() Download the Brazilian Aeronautical Registry (RAB) Current function — read_aircrafts() (plural) is hard-deprecated, use singular
read_airport_movements() Download airport passenger/aircraft/cargo/mail movement data Available from Jan 2019 onwards only
read_airfares() Download domestic and international airfare data domestic = TRUE/FALSE switches data source
latest_flights_date() Check the most recent yyyymm date with flight data available Support function

All functions share date, showProgress, and cache roxygen @templates (in man-roxygen/ or inline) — check existing templates before adding a new parameter with the same shape.

Data Source Notes (ANAC)

  • All data is sourced from ANAC’s open-data portals — URLs are documented per-function in the roxygen @description blocks in R/, not duplicated here (avoid drift between two copies of the same URL).
  • read_airport_movements() and read_airfares()/read_flights() (date-parameterized functions) depend on ANAC publishing cadence — “latest available month” logic lives in utils_*.R per data type + latest_flights_date().
  • Record ANAC-specific quirks (encoding, schema changes, broken URLs, rate limits) as [LEARN:anac] entries in MEMORY.md as they’re discovered, rather than re-deriving them each session.
